visualCharacteristics.purpose: Product attribute list: small line icons, each beside a short label; some labels link to a related page
visualCharacteristics.layout: Light grey box with items in two top-to-bottom columns at every width; 30px inline icon before its label

contentPattern.structure: One row per attribute. cell 1: icon image; cell 2: label text, or a link whose text is the label. Any number of rows; empty cells are dropped

usage: Feature/attribute summary (mounting, certifications, capacity) beside the product overview on product detail pages.
reuseGuidance: Use for short icon + label facts. For icon quick-links in a row use cards-icon-links; for image cards with descriptions use cards-solutions.
